name: Keith Faber
summary: Keith Lloyd Faber (born January 19, 1966) is an American lawyer and politician from Ohio. A  Republican, he has been State Auditor of Ohio since 2019. He was the Republican nominee for Ohio Attorney General in 2026, losing to Democrat John Kulewicz.
